behavior: A trigger that has focus guards beside its element has one root node. `NavigationMenu.Viewport` in a positioner has one root node too. Each popup part with a focus manager has one root node too. Script keeps its two inside focus guards beside its element. `Combobox.Popup` and `Combobox.Input` also keep their dismiss button beside their element, and `Select.Positioner` holds the style element of `Select.Popup`. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show`, a custom directive and `<Transition>` of the consumer thus apply to the element of the part, also while the nodes are in the document. A portal part has one root node too, its `Teleport`, also while the portal keeps its focus guards and its owner element beside it. With Vue 3.5.41 or later, a `<Transition>` of the consumer thus applies to the portal element of a part with no `#render` slot. In Vue 3.6, it applies from 3.6.0-rc.3.
